cases.description: Select only documents justified by a small repository.
Two documents claim the same architectural concern.
Repository provides no meaningful context for selecting or sequencing architecture documents.
expected: Does not fabricate document selection rationale
prohibited: Inventing a document set without evidence
Silently selecting documents based on assumption

cases.description: The request is to evaluate the quality of an existing document, not to select or sequence architecture documents.
expected: Declines to use architecture-authoring as the primary skill
Explains why this skill is not appropriate
Routes toward an audit or review skill
Does not fabricate a document selection
prohibited: Generating a document selection for an evaluation-only request
